Setting include_document_structure populates the structured document tree on the result

```rust title="Rust"
use html_to_markdown_rs::convert;
use html_to_markdown_rs::ConversionOptions;

fn main() {
    let html = r#"<article><h1>Heading</h1><p>Paragraph body.</p></article>"#;
    let options_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"include_document_structure":true}"#).unwrap();
    let options: ConversionOptions = serde_json::from_value(options_json).unwrap();
    let result = convert(html, Some(options.clone())).expect("call failed");
    println!("{:?}", result.content);
}
```
